plan.summary: DIR-093 recon complete, done against the reference image and the live tree, and I am leading with a SUPERSESSION I will not quietly perform. Area 1 replaces CopilotHeroHud.jsx, and area 6 replaces the AiCareerBriefing + CandidateExecutiveRail pair. Those two surfaces are PINNED by six test files: cuba-candidate-portal.test.mjs, dir077, dir084, dir085, dir086 and dir091. I predicted this class of breakage in DIR-091 and it happened there too (6 pins), so I am naming it up front: implementing areas 1 and 6 WILL break those pins. My rule is the DIR-091 rule - RETARGET every superseded assertion so its original intent survives (a real header surface, a real rail bound to real reads, exactly one h1, the honest-placeholder contract), and NEVER delete a previous directive guard. Second: the reference numbers are ILLUSTRATION, not specification. The screenshot shows 5 resumes, 69 percent ATS, 1 application, 3 job matches, 92/86/78 percent match and the companies Google/Accenture/Infosys. None of those may be hardcoded - every value binds to getResumes, summariseResumes/calculateAtsScore, getStatesOfUser and the real matching module, and an unavailable read renders an explicit placeholder rather than a fabricated zero. Third, and this is the one real BUG I found in the existing code: DashboardHomepage.jsx:1414-1420 renders the card date as document.item.created_at.seconds times 1000 OR Date.now(). A resume with no timestamp therefore renders TODAY, which is a fabricated date. The shared formatSafeDate already exists from DIR-048; I will route the card through it and render an explicit placeholder when the date is genuinely unknown. Fourth: area 5, the bottom analytics, is NOT in this directive - it is DIR-094, because it is the only greenfield subsystem and my sweep confirms it does not exist anywhere in src.

S2 Area 1 supersession: retarget the CopilotHeroHud pins in the six affected suites so each original intent is preserved, and declare in-file why.

S3 Area 2 metric card polish: add the trailing chevron, the real trend chip, the Target 80 percent line, the Start a session link and per-card navigation to the four DIR-091 cards, deriving deltas from real data and omitting the chip when the delta is unavailable.

S4 Area 3 toolbar: segmented All Resumes/Tailored/Master/Drafts pills with real counts, the Ctrl+K search binding, a working Sort dropdown (Last Updated/ATS/Title) and a working Grid/List toggle, with zero dead controls.
S5 Area 4 resume cards: real Master/Tailored/Draft badge, Updated date via formatSafeDate, the ATS chip, a job-matches chip only when a real source exists, and the dashed Create a New Resume card.
S6 Area 4 defect fix: replace the Date.now() fallback with formatSafeDate and prove an unknown date never renders today.

S7 Area 6 AI Career Assistant rail: the Live badge, the three tabs, the four quick-action cards, the prompt input with send, the prompt chips and the Today insights block, all over real reads with honest empty states.
S8 Area 6 supersession: retarget the rail pins in the affected suites, preserving intent.

S9 Author tests/dir093-candidate-dashboard-reference-parity.test.mjs, register test:dir093, run the full pinned suite plus build, lint, frozen-template and XAMPP gates, and submit evidence stating precisely which of areas 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 landed.
